name: shopkeep
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends socat && sudo chown vscode:vscode /workspaces/shopkeep/web/node_modules && echo 'Shopkeep devcontainer ready — see CLAUDE.md and the design vault for guidance.'
postStartCommand: /bin/sh -c 'pkill -f "socat TCP6-LISTEN:5556" 2>/dev/null; setsid socat TCP6-LISTEN:5556,fork,reuseaddr,ipv6only=0 TCP:dex:5556 </dev/null >/tmp/socat-dex.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; pgrep -f "socat TCP6-LISTEN:5556" >/dev/null && echo dex-bridge-up || echo dex-bridge-FAILED; exit 0'
